Bug_Title: USELESS_STRING: Invocation of toString on an unnamed array (DMI_INVOKING_TOSTRING_ON_ANONYMOUS_ARRAY)
Bug_Details:
The code invokes toString on an (anonymous) array.  Calling toString on an array generates a fairly useless result
such as [C@16f0472. Consider using Arrays.toString to convert the array into a readable
String that gives the contents of the array. See Programming Puzzlers, chapter 3, puzzle 12.
Bug_Explanation: The code calls toString() on an unnamed array, which results in a default Java object string representation like [I@16f0472, instead of a readable list of values. This is not useful for understanding the array contents.
Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case calls the method showBug, which contains the bug by invoking toString on an unnamed array. The test expects a properly formatted string representation of the array contents, but the method returns the default object string representation, causing the test assertion to fail.
